Code generation abstract syntax tree

Source: R/codegen-ast.R
codegen-ast.Rd

Nodes of an abstract syntax tree for code generation, after SymPy's sympy.codegen.ast. Each constructor takes its fields positionally or by name, as the SymPy classes do: for example Variable(x, type = real), Assignment(x, y + 1), For(i, Range(10), list(aug_assign(s, "+", i))) or FunctionDefinition(real, "f", list(x), list(Return(x^2))). The nodes print through the code printers such as ccode() and fcode(). aug_assign(lhs, op, rhs) builds the augmented assignment for the operator op. The objects real, sym_integer, complex_, bool_, intc, float32, float64 and the rest are the predefined types; value_const and pointer_const are attributes; none is the None token.

Arguments

...

The fields of the node, positionally or by name.

lhs, rhs

Left and right hand sides of an assignment.

op

An operator: "+", "-", "*", "/" or "%".

Value

A sym node.

Examples

x <- Symbol("x"); y <- Symbol("y")
Assignment(x, y + 1)
#> Assignment(x, y + 1)
Variable(x, type = real)
#> Variable(x, type=real)
CodeBlock(Assignment(x, 1), aug_assign(x, "+", y))
#> CodeBlock(
#> Assignment(x, 1),
#> AddAugmentedAssignment(x, y)
#> )
